tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Find a prescription medicine. Give the barcode on the pack, a national pack code or an authorisation number, or the name or active substance exactly as the regulator publishes it. Narrow by country, maker, strength, form or pack size. Returns the one signed record, or the candidates and the fields i

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get a medicine's full record: what it is, who makes it, its status with the regulator, each field with its source page and read date. Give a past date to see the record as it stood then.

tools.name: related_records
tools.description: Find the same medicine in other countries. Each link is labelled "same product" or "same substance, strength and form". A link does not say one product can be used in place of another.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Follow what changed. Returns every change to a country's medicine records since a point you name.

tools.name: get_checkpoint
tools.description: Get the signed checkpoint of a country's change history.

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Check a record's signature against Dosidal's public keys.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the countries Dosidal holds medicine records for, each with its regulator and its counts.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, name, substance, market, maker, strength, form, pack_size, page, page_size
